name: Construction duration norms
summary: Start-to-completion months by project type and construction value, from the Census Bureau's C30 length-of-time tables (2024–2025 completions) and NAHB's summary of the Survey of Construction for single-family homes.
method: The engine maps each project type to a Census category (catalog.json durationClass), estimates the component's hard cost, and takes the months for that value band; a phase lasts as long as its longest component.

items.name: Construction duration — Office

range.method: low/high = smallest and largest value band; mid = 'All Values'. extra.bands gives months by project value (maxValue in dollars, null = no upper bound).

items.notes: Census reports durations by the project's construction value; the engine picks the band for the component's estimated hard cost.

range.method: Built for sale 7.4 months permit to completion (mid); built for rent 12.4; contractor-built custom 11.7; owner-built 14.3 (e6).

items.notes: NAHB summary of the Census Survey of Construction.
